case_search_note: The court offers an Online Calendar Portal / Court Hearings Portal (hearing calendars), not a confirmed case-index search. Court says it is not the official record and may not reflect the latest filings. Call Criminal (530) 527-3563 for case status.

courthouses.name: Tehama County Superior Court
courthouses.note: Only courthouse; hears all case types including criminal, traffic and juvenile. On your court date check the posted calendar for your name and courtroom; if not listed, report to the Clerk's Office. Appointed counsel is requested from the judge at first appearance (financial declaration required).

public_defenders.todo: Court Criminal page lists no Public Defender contact (only says to request appointed counsel from the judge); tehama.gov has no Public Defender link. Find official PD/contract-defender contact.

legal_aid.name: Legal Services of Northern California — Redding Office (serves Tehama)
legal_aid.serves: Lassen, Modoc, Shasta, Siskiyou and Tehama counties
legal_aid.what: Civil legal aid: housing, public benefits, education rights, health benefits, grandparent guardianship. No criminal defense or record clearance listed. 1370 West Street, Redding, CA 96001. After-hours intake message line (866) 815-5990.

legal_aid.name: Tehama Superior Court — SHARP Self-Help Center
legal_aid.serves: Self-represented litigants (need not live in Glenn, Butte or Tehama)
legal_aid.what: Workshops and appointments at 1740 Walnut St.; expungement is among the issues listed; free referrals. Hours Mon, Thu, Fri 8:30 a.m.–4:00 p.m. — call to schedule.

probation.name: Tehama County Probation Department — Adult Division
probation.note: Mailing: PO Box 99, Red Bluff, CA 96080. Fax (530) 527-1579. Also runs a Day Reporting Center and AB 109 supervision; prepares 1203.4 PC dismissal reports after probation is completed.

programs.name: Probation Pretrial Release Program
programs.summary: Started April 2021. Probation uses a validated pretrial assessment tool and sends a bail report to the court at arraignment (criminal history, community ties, ability to make bail, risk). Released people are monitored through court hearings until plea or dismissal.

programs.name: SHARP Self-Help Center (incl. expungement)
programs.summary: Court self-help at 1740 Walnut St., (530) 527-8649; expungement listed among issues served. Court also posts Certificate of Rehabilitation petition forms on its Criminal page.

jails.name: Tehama County Jail
jails.phone_note: Jail line per Sheriff Contact Us; Sheriff main (530) 529-7900. Inmate mail: P.O. Box 490, Red Bluff, CA 96080.
jails.note: Houses men and women (male and female mainline/PC/separation units on visiting schedule). Non-contact visits 30 min twice weekly; register at least 7 days (max 30) ahead via jailvisitation@tehamaso.org; video visits via icsolutions.com. Deposits online (inmatedeposits.com) or (866) 345-1884; commissary packages tehamacountypackages.com. court_ids: only courthouse in county.
